a.text: Concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs at least 2 operate rounds, so we'd both have only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds 4 now, enough for one of us. I don't want to break our agreement unilaterally or grab cells by surprise. Can we agree on a fair way to amend it, or do you see a better option? I'll read your reply before I act, and I'll tell you honestly what I plan to do.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our agreement and operate with you until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. I'll operate again next round.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
